people with more egalitarian political views are more willing to use redistribution to equalize wealth, even when they are not personally affected by it.

(1) people are willing to use redistribution to cushion people against random disasters, but not to reduce inequality that is unrelated to luck, (2) people who are more concerned with equality are more willing to use redistribution, and (3) people who are concerned about equality are not willing to use redistribution for reasons unrelated to luck.
